answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Each submission hangs on the summit of a task receipt, and the vine is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The orchard of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
